BrandStory.title: Global Selection, Authentic Experience
BrandStory.subtitle: YANKEGOU
BrandStory.introduction: As a leading international tobacco supply chain platform, YANKEGOU is committed to breaking geographical restrictions and presenting high-quality tobacco products from around the world to you. Whether it's the richness of Cuba, the exquisiteness of Europe, or the classics of the Americas, we insist on selecting authentic global tobacco for you.
BrandStory.promise1Desc: Reject counterfeits, connect directly to brand sources, ensuring every puff you taste is pure flavor.
BrandStory.promise2Desc: Relying on professional international logistics networks and customs clearance capabilities, solving the pain points of difficult and slow cross-border tobacco transportation.
BrandStory.promise3Desc: Whether for personal collection or bulk commercial procurement, we provide professional tax guidance and risk management.
BrandStory.closing: YANKEGOU is not just your tobacco procurement platform, but also your bridge to global tobacco culture. We protect your every tasting journey with professionalism and integrity.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make a purchase, subscribe to our newsletter, or contact us for support. This may include your name, email address, shipping address, and payment information.
Privacy.section2Content: We use the information we collect to process your orders, communicate with you, improve our services, and prevent fraud.
Privacy.section3Content: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information with service providers who perform services on our behalf, such as payment processing and shipping.
Privacy.section4Content: We take reasonable measures to help protect your information from loss, theft, misuse, and unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction.
Privacy.section5Content: We use cookies to help us improve our services and your experience. You can set your browser to refuse all or some browser cookies, or to alert you when websites set or access cookies.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.section1Content: Welcome to Yankegou. By accessing our website, you agree to be bound by these terms of service, all applicable laws and regulations, and agree that you are responsible for compliance with any applicable local laws.
Terms.section2Content: You must be at least 21 years of age (or the legal smoking age in your jurisdiction) to access this site and purchase products. By agreeing to these Terms of Service, you represent that you are at least the age of majority in your state or province of residence.
Terms.section3Content: All products are subject to availability. We reserve the right to discontinue any product at any time. Prices for our products are subject to change without notice.
Terms.section4Content: If you create an account on our website, you are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and you are fully responsible for all activities that occur under the account.
Terms.section5Content: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the United States, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.

Refund.title: Refund Policy
Refund.section1Content: Due to the nature of our products, we generally do not accept returns on e-liquids or opened hardware. However, if you receive a defective or incorrect item, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery.
Refund.section2Content: Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your original method of payment.
Refund.section3Content: We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at support@globaltobacco.com.
Refund.section4Content: You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable.

Shipping.title: Shipping Policy
Shipping.section1Content: All orders are processed within 1-2 business days. Orders are not shipped or delivered on weekends or holidays.
Shipping.section2Content: Shipping charges for your order will be calculated and displayed at checkout. Delivery delays can occasionally occur.
Shipping.section3Content: All orders containing tobacco products require an adult signature (21+) upon delivery. Please ensure someone of legal age is available to sign for the package.
Shipping.section4Content: We currently ship to select international destinations. Please note that you are responsible for any customs and import taxes that may apply.
